extract_ir: extract JIT IR graphs from a log file by parsing GRAPH_EXPORT delimited sections
load_graph_and_inputs: load a TorchScript IR string and auto-generate random inputs matching each graph input type
run_test: run a JIT graph with warmup and timed execution on CPU or CUDA
run_nnc: run a JIT graph using the NN Compiler (fuser1) with static or dynamic fusion strategy
run_nvfuser: run a JIT graph using the NVFuser (fuser2) fusion backend
